title: Street pencils in more hikes after today

timeline.title: Street pencils in more hikes after today
timeline.line: BofA sees 100 bps of RBI hikes through H1 2027, with the first 25 bps now delivered
more: Several analysts expect another 25 bps hike in December
BofA cites resilient growth and broadening inflation risks
Oil at $100–110 for most of September is a key pressure
